description:
READ-ONLY declarative dependency check, meant to run AFTER `install` but BEFORE
    installing apps into a DB. The Odoo deb ships every module's code on disk, so this
    parses `external_dependencies` from the __manifest__.py of the apps you PLAN to
    install PLUS their transitive `depends` closure (not just already-DB-installed
    modules), maps them to apt packages, and reports which are missing / not yet
    pre-seeded (odoo_deps.KNOWN_APT). Declarative complement to the empirical warm
    scan: it can name a NEW app's dep from the manifest instead of only by failure.
    Changes nothing. Pass a plan to scope to its apps; omit to scan ALL modules.
name: deps_scan
